method: Three whole pinned benchmark/test files read. Original dependency-free utilities and AST-extracted ground-truth function plus5 original test method bodies executed locally. pandas evaluation not executed.
findings: classify_prediction labels a nonempty superset of all ground-truth duplicates asTP even with additional false matches; partial correct subsets becomeFP. Local101prediction/1truth control yieldsTP but pair precision1/101. This class metric differs from standard pair-confusion counting.

evaluate_predictions computes macro_f1 as mean duplicate/nonduplicate precisions, explicitly acknowledged by source comment and mirrored by test. It is not harmonic F1; table nonetheless labels Macro F1 Score.

Exact-match accuracy is calculated separately, so overinclusiveTP can coexist with failed exact match. Labels-empty whole-dataset handling builds no columns before df exact_match indexing; no full empty-data evaluation executed.

prepare_ground_truth coerces core_id tostr but leaves labelled_duplicates member types unchanged. Synthetic integer labels produce string keys with integer duplicate members, potentially mismatching string predictions. Five original ground-truth tests allpass with their existing string-only fixtures.

MinHash mapping converter assumes every member is explicitly present, while SimHash converter adds parent representatives; this matches reviewed mapping shapes. Missing/falsy core IDs skipped silently.

Benchmark wrappers with supplied dataset temporarily change read_arguments and create fixed temp_dataset under output. Restore/removal are not in finally; algorithm failure can retain changed config/temp data. Input config subtype is not replaced when switching argument shape.
When save_clusters false, wrappers assume empty predictions rather than distinguishing unavailable mapping. Full algorithm output quality cannot be inferred from such run.
Precision(empty,empty)=0 while recall(empty,empty)=1 in helper; zero-support convention must be stated when comparing benchmark scores.

result.scope: Original dependency-free benchmark helpers and original ground-truth function plus5original test method bodies; no pandas evaluation or dataset benchmark run.

limits: No full pandas/datasets benchmark execution or production changes. Upstream evaluation tests read, only5ground-truth methods executed. pHash/ASAN deferred.
